# Easy Indian Visa Status

> Check the status of an Indian visa application across multiple official sources at once: Passtrack (IVAC), the Indian government visa portal, and the Indian Mission in Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Track a visa application](https://track.easyindianvisa.com/): Enter an application ID and passport number to check status across all sources simultaneously.
- [System status](https://track.easyindianvisa.com/status): Live uptime and health of each data source, checked automatically every 2 hours.
- [Privacy Policy](https://track.easyindianvisa.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Use](https://track.easyindianvisa.com/terms-and-condition)
